title: Que H
content: I was 15 and had experienced a lot of trauma in my life. I was depressed and miserable, searching for peace, and more than anything, I didn’t want to be here anymore. I stole a bottle of sleeping pills, wrote a goodbye letter, and took all of them one night. I fell asleep quickly, and then everything went black. I’ve read *Embraced by the Light*, and now I believe I was in the tunnel she described, where souls that didn’t move on remain. But at the time, I had no understanding of any of this. All I knew was that I was in a void, and it wasn’t scary. I was more anxious to find the peace you’re always promised in death and confused about where I was. A light appeared above me, like a spotlight. I couldn’t see beyond the edges of the light. But, I knew if I stepped out of the light, I would be lost forever. By being lost, this was not in the sense of being damned or punished for my suicide. I would simply be lost, as a matter of fact. Now, I’d say it was because I hadn’t evolved past my pain enough to open up to anything else, good or bad. I would have been stuck in a kind of limbo. At the time, I didn’t understand any of this. I stayed still, and outside the light’s edge, where I couldn’t see, I sensed people. I don’t know how I sensed them because I couldn’t see anyone. It was like I saw them in my mind. There was a table of men who were judging. At the time, I thought they were judging me, but maybe they were debating how much help to give me. I’m not sure. I could hear them in my head. Sadly, that didn’t make their words any clearer. Then, suddenly, I heard a voice rise above the others, and when I did, I knew it was my grandfather, who had died when I was three months old. He said, "She has to go back. She has more to do." Then it was like a gavel dropped. I woke up in my bed and was completely fine. I don’t know how. I should be dead. I took an entire bottle of pills that should have killed me. I had no medical intervention, yet I’m alive today.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain, Suicide attempt, Other (briefly specify), I'm not sure. I took an entire bottle of sleeping pills. I wasn't found, and woke up in the morning.
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness, The only thing that stands out about my consciousness is that it wasn't my normal sleep consciousness. My consciousness felt like it feels when I'm awake.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual, My experience was quick. When it was over and I woke up, hours had passed.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I didn't hear with my ears. I heard with my mind.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes, I was in darkness and surrounded by darkness. That's where my memory of the event starts.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes, My grandfather died in a car accident when I was three months old. I heard a voice and pictured him in my head. Somehow, I knew it was him.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, The light shone down on me. I think it saved me.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: Some unfamiliar and strange place, It was just a void where I only saw blackness.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Religious unaffiliated, At the time, I was more angry with God than anything. I wasn't trying to kill myself to find God; I was simply looking for peace.
elements.What is your religion now?: Other or several faiths, I believe in God but don't subscribe to any religious organization.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I thought I would find peace and be free; but I was told I had to go back and had more to do.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I knew I was here for a reason.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, Only my grandfather saying I had to go back because I had more to do.
Yes, I experienced my grandfather's voice, and yet he had been dead for 15 years at that point.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I always felt like there was something more beyond this existence. Afterward, I knew there was.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, I've cut toxic people out of my life and I'm still trying to be more open with people.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Uncertain, Only in the sense that I wasn't sure it was real.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, It's been 30 years, and I still remember it like it was yesterday.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, Only seeing a tunnel of light and heaven.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was probably not real, I wasn't sure it was real. I thought it might have been a dream.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, After reading 'Embraced by the Light' and other NDE accounts, what else could it be? Their experiences resonate with mine.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, Everything I've said gives as accurate a description as I could.
